description: This file contains implementation details and function definitions related to autograd functions, derivatives, backward functions, and utility functions for PyTorch's autograd system, specifically for manual autograd functions in the torch/csrc/autograd directory.

classes.name: Tensor
classes.description: Represents a multi-dimensional array used for tensor computations with autograd support in PyTorch.

methods.name: apply_simple_transformation
methods.description: Applies a simple transformation involving householder reflectors, with options for in-place modification and conditions.

methods.name: householder_product_jvp
methods.description: Computes the Jacobian-vector product for the householder product operation.

methods.name: ormqr_backward
methods.description: Computes the backward pass for the QR factorization operation with orthogonal matrix Q.

methods.name: polar_backward
methods.description: Backward computation for the polar decomposition of tensors.

methods.name: i1_backward
methods.description: Backward implementation for the I1 Bessel function.

methods.name: i1e_backward
methods.description: Backward implementation for the scaled I1e Bessel function.

methods.name: linalg_lu_solve_LU
methods.description: Computes the backward pass for LU solve operation given LU factors and pivots.

methods.name: linalg_lu_solve_jvp
methods.description: Computes the Jacobian-vector product for LU solve operation.

methods.name: linalg_lu_backward
methods.description: Calculates the gradients for LU factorization components during backpropagation.

methods.name: lu_factor_ex_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for LU factorization with extended features.

methods.name: logsumexp_jvp
methods.description: Computes the Jacobian-vector product for log-sum-exp operation.

methods.name: safe_logsumexp_jvp
methods.description: Robust Jacobian-vector product for log-sum-exp that handles edge cases.

methods.name: scatter_reduce_jvp
methods.description: Computes the Jacobian-vector product for the scatter_reduce operation.

methods.name: to_sparse_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for conversion to sparse tensors.

methods.name: linalg_lu_unpack_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for unpacking LU factors.

methods.name: lu_unpack_backward
methods.description: Wrapper for LU unpack backward pass.

methods.name: lu_factor_ex_jvp
methods.description: Jacobian-vector product for extended LU factorization.

methods.name: lu_factor_ex_backward
methods.description: Backward computation for extended LU factorization.
